title: Optimal measurement-based quantum thermal machines in a finite-size system
summary: We present a measurement-based quantum thermal machine that extracts work from the back-action of generalized quantum measurements whose working medium is a coupled two-level quantum system. Specifically, we derive universal optimization criteria for a three-stroke measurement-based engine cycle with coupled two-level system of Ising-like interaction as a working medium. Furthermore, we present two numerical algorithms to optimize the engine work extraction and enhance its performance.
